name: Turnkey Construction
shortDescription: Single-contract delivery from drawing board to handover keys.
description: One contract, one accountable team. We take the project from soil test and drawings through structure, finishing, statutory approvals and final handover, with a fixed timeline written into the agreement.

name: PEB Industrial Sheds
shortDescription: Pre-engineered steel buildings up to 12m clear height.
description: Design, fabrication and erection of pre-engineered steel buildings for warehousing, weaving and processing units. IS 800 compliant, delivered with structural drawings and third-party test certificates.

name: RCC Structure Works
shortDescription: Seismic-compliant RCC framed and shear-wall structures.
description: Reinforced concrete structural work for towers, podiums and basements. Mix designs are lab-certified per pour and cube-tested at 7 and 28 days, with reports shared with the client.

name: Interior Fit-Out
shortDescription: Corporate and residential interiors delivered to spec.
description: Complete fit-out of offices, showrooms and homes: false ceiling, partitions, modular furniture, lighting design and MEP coordination, executed by the same team that built the shell.

name: Land Development
shortDescription: Plotting, NA conversion and internal infrastructure.
description: End-to-end land development: survey and layout, NA conversion support, internal tar roads, storm drainage, street lighting, boundary walls and water infrastructure, handed over ready to build on.

name: Project Management Consultancy
shortDescription: Run your own project with our site discipline.
description: For owners who want to build directly, we supply the planning, procurement discipline, quality checks and billing controls, with weekly progress reporting and a live cost-to-complete view.

name: Renovation and Retrofit
shortDescription: Structural strengthening and full building renovation.
description: Structural audit, retrofitting and renovation for ageing buildings: column jacketing, carbon-fibre wrapping, waterproofing overhaul, facade renewal and services replacement.

name: Ready-Mix and Materials
shortDescription: Batching-plant concrete and certified site materials.
description: Ready-mix concrete from our own batching plant plus supply of certified steel, blocks and aggregates, delivered on schedule with batch slips and test certificates for every consignment.
